wiki:
Available from Anita (Handicrafts maid) in Vecchio Palace of Florence (accessed from Pisa by carriage).

Skill: Handicrafts (R10)
Ingredients:
Wine x1
Honey x2
Prunes x2
200 Florentine Handicrafts points

Oxford Expedited Advanced Production skill refunds 30% of Florentine points.
